using System;
using System.IO;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using MediaBrowser.Common.Configuration;
using MediaBrowser.Controller.MediaEncoding;
using MediaBrowser.Model.Configuration;
using MediaBrowser.Model.IO;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

namespace MediaBrowser.Controller.MediaEncoding.Tests
{
    public class TranscodingSegmentCleanerTests
    {
        private readonly Mock<ILogger<TranscodingSegmentCleaner>> _loggerMock;
        private readonly Mock<IConfigurationManager> _configMock;
        private readonly Mock<IFileSystem> _fileSystemMock;
        private readonly Mock<IMediaEncoder> _mediaEncoderMock;
        private readonly TranscodingJob _job;

        public TranscodingSegmentCleanerTests()
        {
            _loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger<TranscodingSegmentCleaner>>();
            _configMock = new Mock<IConfigurationManager>();
            _fileSystemMock = new Mock<IFileSystem>();
            _mediaEncoderMock = new Mock<IMediaEncoder>();

            _job = new TranscodingJob
            {
                Path = "/path/to/segments/segment.m3u8",
                Type = TranscodingJobType.Hls,
                DownloadPositionTicks = 180000000000 // 180 seconds * TimeSpan.TicksPerSecond
            };
        }

        [Fact]
        public void DeleteSegmentFiles_LogsDebugMessageWithCorrectParameters()
        {
            // Arrange
            var cleaner = new TranscodingSegmentCleaner(
                _job, _loggerMock.Object, _configMock.Object, _fileSystemMock.Object, _mediaEncoderMock.Object, 10);

            // Act
            var deleteTask = cleaner.DeleteSegmentFiles(_job, 5, 10, 100);

            // Since it's async void internally but we call the private method directly via reflection for testing
            // The log call happens synchronously before the await
            deleteTask.Wait(1000); // Wait for completion

            // Assert
            _loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Debug,
                    0,
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => ContainsLogMessage(v, "Deleting segment file(s) index 5 to 10 from /path/to/segments/segment.m3u8")),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task DeleteSegmentFiles_CallsLogDebug_BeforeDelay()
        {
            // Arrange
            var options = new EncodingOptions { EnableSegmentDeletion = true, SegmentKeepSeconds = 20 };
            _configMock.Setup(x => x.GetEncodingOptions()).Returns(options);

            var cleaner = new TranscodingSegmentCleaner(
                _job, _loggerMock.Object, _configMock.Object, _fileSystemMock.Object, _mediaEncoderMock.Object, 10);

            // Use reflection to call private method since it's not virtual/public
            var method = typeof(TranscodingSegmentCleaner).GetMethod("DeleteSegmentFiles", 
                System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance);
            
            // Act
            await (Task)method!.Invoke(cleaner, new object[] { _job, 1, 5, 500 })!;

            // Assert - log should have been called
            _loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.LogDebug("Deleting segment file(s) index {Min} to {Max} from {Path}", 1L, 5L, _job.Path),
                Times.Once);
        }

        private static bool ContainsLogMessage<TState>(TState state, string expectedMessage)
        {
            return state?.ToString()?.Contains(expectedMessage) == true;
        }
    }
}
